cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You like the blue campaign poster? I'll tell the volunteers they're happy with me in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The colour, yes. Could we work on the slogan together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Of course. I'm glad everyone's accepted my collaborative leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. My first act as campaign leader is to delegate the decision.

mechanism: A grants collaboration and delegates the final choice as if partial agreement to design work has already confirmed A leadership.
confusable: D52 seeks visible endorsement; D71 incorrectly treats limited creative cooperation as endorsement already given.
comparison: A poster design collaboration differs from a meeting attendee explicitly opposing the budget.
seedUse: Retain D71-b cooperative slogan solution becoming a supposed first leadership act.
